list_config_files: list all YAML config files recursively under a directory path with optional filtering predicate
exclude_folders: create a predicate function that filters out config file paths containing specified folder names
create_valid_input: convert config file paths from config/ prefix to config= CLI-style override format
SSLHydraConfig_from_configs: create an SSLHydraConfig instance initialized from a list of config files
SSLHydraConfig_override: override an SSLHydraConfig instance with new config files merged via OmegaConf
